title: AUTOSAR Engineer
summary: AUTOSAR engineers build and configure the software inside car control units (ECUs) using AUTOSAR, a standard layered software architecture used across the auto industry. They sit in embedded automotive teams at carmakers, suppliers and engineering service firms, next to hardware, testing and diagnostics teams.
dailyDuties: Configure BSW, RTE and MCAL modules in AUTOSAR tools
Integrate software components and generate ECU builds
Implement and test UDS diagnostic services
Debug CAN and LIN communication with network tools
Fix integration bugs on the target microcontroller
Review code for MISRA and process rules

skills.expectation: Configure and integrate AUTOSAR Classic BSW, RTE and MCAL modules with tools like DaVinci or EB tresos
Write MISRA-compliant Embedded C for ECU software components
Work with CAN, LIN and other in-vehicle buses
Implement UDS diagnostics and test network traffic with CANoe or CANalyzer
Bring up software on automotive microcontrollers
Debug ECU software with on-target debuggers and traces
Configure AUTOSAR OS tasks, alarms and scheduling
Work on Adaptive AUTOSAR applications in C++
Write unit and integration tests for software components
Script build, configuration and test steps
Manage code and configuration in version control
Work in sprints with the vehicle programme team
